type.numbers: ui-rounded, tabular figures, large percent and year count

layout: Single page up to 1120px: header with Add a book; 'Reading now' cards in a responsive grid (drawn cloth cover, big percent, bookmark track, pages to go with a pace estimate, one control row: page field, Finished it, remove). Then a full-width year shelf: figures (books, pages, average rating, pace) left, twelve month bays right (two rows of six on phone). Below, two columns on desktop: want-to-read pile left, finished list right; stacked on phone.
signature: Books as objects: a year bookcase with one bay per month where each finished book stands as a spine in the month it was finished (thickness by pages, rating as gilt dots, months still to come hatched); the want-to-read pile as cloth books lying flat (thickness by page count); progress as a gilt ribbon bookmark over a page-edge track.
mood: A well-kept home bookshelf: deep cloth bindings, gilt details, warm wood, calm neutral page in light and dark.
